WITH raw_data AS ( SELECT em.organization_id AS employee_org ,em.employee_number AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,em.grade_title AS employee_grade ,em.attribute10 AS actual_shift_code ,em.assignment_category AS employee_category ,em.date_hire_subsidiary AS date_hire_subsidiary ,to_char(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS attendance_date ,ac.time_and_attendance_type_code AS actual_attendance_type ,t.time_and_attendance_code AS actual_attendance_detail -- OT Level : OS 직원(Grade L34)만 대상, 근무일수 = 근태일자 - 입사일(DATE_HIRE_SUBSIDIARY) + 1 (입사일 = 1일차) 기준 (~29일 : Level 1, 30~59일 : Level 2, 60일~ : Level 3) ,CASE WHEN em.grade = 'L34' AND em.date_hire_subsidiary IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN TRUNC(t.time_and_attendance_date) - TRUNC(em.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 <= 29 THEN 'Level 1' WHEN TRUNC(t.time_and_attendance_date) - TRUNC(em.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 <= 59 THEN 'Level 2' ELSE 'Level 3' END END AS ot_level
,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'year_total_ot_result') AS year_ot ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'month_total_ot_result') AS month_total_ot

-- holiday_day ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'holiday_day','month_total_ot') AS holiday_day ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'holiday_day','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS holiday_day_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'holiday_day','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS holiday_day_over_y_raw
-- public_holiday_day ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'public_holiday_day','month_total_ot') AS public_holiday_day ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'public_holiday_day','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS public_holiday_day_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'public_holiday_day','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS public_holiday_day_over_y_raw
-- weekday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'weekday_night','month_total_ot') AS weekday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'weekday_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'weekday_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_night_over_y_raw
-- weekday_af_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'weekday_af_night','month_total_ot') AS weekday_af_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'weekday_af_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_af_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'weekday_af_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS weekday_af_night_over_y_raw
-- holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'holiday_night','month_total_ot') AS holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'holiday_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS holiday_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'holiday_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS holiday_night_over_y_raw
-- public_holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'public_holiday_night','month_total_ot') AS public_holiday_night ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'public_holiday_night','month_total_ot_over_limit') AS ph_night_over_m_raw ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_item_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, t.time_and_attendance_date, t.time_and_attendance_date,'public_holiday_night','year_total_ot_over_limit') AS ph_night_over_y_raw
FROM tb_att_result_n t, emp_master em, tb_att_code_c ac WHERE em.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND t.employee_no = em.employee_number AND t.subsidiary_code = ac.subsidiary_code(+) AND t.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code(+) AND t.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{atendanceStartDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') -- 근태일자 기준 재직자 (검색 시작일 기준 X) AND em.date_hire_subsidiary <= t.time_and_attendance_date AND (em.date_retire >= t.time_and_attendance_date OR em.date_retire IS NULL) AND NVL(em.fse_yn, 'N') <> 'Y' AND NVL(em.flsa_yn, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND em.attribute10 = #{shiftCode}
AND em.assignment_category = #{categoryTitle}
AND em.grade = 'L34'
AND NVL(em.grade, ' ') <> 'L34'
AND em.organization_id = #{orgId}
AND em.employee_number = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(em.full_name_local) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'MONTH'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') >= #{monthTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'MONTH'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') <= #{monthTotalOtTo}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'YEAR'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result') >= #{yearTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'YEAR'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result') <= #{yearTotalOtTo}
) SELECT employee_org ,employee_no ,employee_name ,employee_grade ,actual_shift_code ,employee_category ,TO_CHAR(date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_hire_subsidiary ,attendance_date ,actual_attendance_type ,actual_attendance_detail ,ot_level ,year_ot ,month_total_ot
,weekday_day ,CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN weekday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_day_over_y_raw END AS weekday_day_over_y
,holiday_day ,CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS holiday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_day_over_y_raw END AS holiday_day_over_y
,public_holiday_day ,CASE WHEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw > public_holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS public_holiday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw > public_holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE public_holiday_day_over_y_raw END AS public_holiday_day_over_y
,weekday_night ,CASE WHEN weekday_night_over_m_raw > weekday_night_over_y_raw THEN weekday_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_night_over_m_raw > weekday_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_night_over_y_raw END AS weekday_night_over_y
,weekday_af_night ,CASE WHEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw > weekday_af_night_over_y_raw THEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_af_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw > weekday_af_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_af_night_over_y_raw END AS weekday_af_night_over_y
,holiday_night ,CASE WHEN holiday_night_over_m_raw > holiday_night_over_y_raw THEN holiday_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS holiday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN holiday_night_over_m_raw > holiday_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_night_over_y_raw END AS holiday_night_over_y
,public_holiday_night ,CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN ph_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS public_holiday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE ph_night_over_y_raw END AS public_holiday_night_over_y
FROM raw_data ORDER BY EMPLOYEE_NO, attendance_date
